subject: Sylvira
fact: Sylvira told Kalan Strongbranch she would intercede with Janussi on his behalf, but never brought it up.
source_quote: She told him she would. She never brought it up.

subject: Sylvira
fact: Sylvira believed Janussi was right to want Kalan gone because he was a clown, a boar, and his research was third-rate.
source_quote: Janussi was right to want him gone. He was a clown, a boar, and his research was third-rate at best.

subject: Sylvira
fact: Sylvira was convinced she had never called Janussi a genus traitor.
source_quote: But she had *never*, she insisted, called him a genus traitor.

subject: Sylvira
fact: Sylvira anticipated being asked whether she called Janussi a genus traitor, which suggested she had prepared a defense.
source_quote: The word "never" had a specificity that suggested she'd anticipated being asked, which was itself worth noting.

subject: Sylvira
fact: Sylvira described the feast as the same drab affair it always was, and left early when the flu began coming on.
source_quote: The feast she described as the same drab affair it always was, right down to the dishes, and she'd left early when the flu began coming on.

subject: Sylvira
fact: Sylvira chose not to comment on whether she knew anything about Alkrist burning something at the feast, responding with diplomatic silence.
source_quote: She received it with the diplomatic silence of someone choosing not to comment on something they either hadn't witnessed or had already assessed as irrelevant.

subject: Sylvira
fact: Sylvira stopped mid-thought and doubled back to ask if anyone had seen her after the party.
source_quote: Then she stopped mid-thought and doubled back to the question I'd asked a minute earlier. "Did you ask me if anyone saw me, after?"

subject: Sylvira
fact: Sylvira admitted she sneaked out after the party to visit her son.
source_quote: I did sneak out. To visit my son.

subject: Sylvira
fact: Sylvira had constructed a Mordenkainen's Mansion specifically to protect her son, who was born in the Abyss.
source_quote: She had a son, born in the Abyss, living in a Mordenkainen's Mansion she'd constructed specifically for his protection.

subject: Sylvira
fact: Sylvira was trying to coax her son back into the Mordenkainen's Mansion.
source_quote: She'd been trying to coax him back into it.

subject: Sylvira
fact: Sylvira felt genuine offense at the suggestion she drank honey, calling it nonsense.
source_quote: Honey? I would *never* drink honey. What kind of nonsense is this?

subject: Sylvira
fact: Sylvira believed that anyone claiming to have seen her after 12:30 was lying and was likely a member of the avowed who harbored hostility toward her.
source_quote: if anyone claimed to have seen her after that, she said with pointed precision, it would be members of the avowed who had long nurtured hostility toward her.

subject: Sylvira
fact: Sylvira named Teles Ahvoste directly as someone who had long nurtured hostility toward her.
source_quote: She named Teles Ahvoste directly.

subject: Sylvira
fact: Sylvira believed jealousy was a powerful motivator for revenge and murder, specifically in reference to Teles's long-standing resentment toward Janussi.
source_quote: "Jealousy is a powerful motivator," she said. "For revenge. Murder."

subject: Sylvira
fact: Sylvira called Kalan's proposal insane and said Bookwyrm had pushed hardest against it.
source_quote: His proposal, which she called insane, all sorts of investigative controls and restrictions. ... Bookwyrm who had pushed hardest against it.

subject: Sylvira
fact: Sylvira had no wristwatch and did not track the precise hour between 12:30 and 1 a.m. because she was feverish and had no reason to.
source_quote: She'd had no wristwatch. She hadn't murdered anyone with midnight tears, so there'd been no reason to track the precise hour.

subject: Sylvira
fact: Sylvira was shivering despite the fire and grieving the last argument she'd had with someone she'd loved.
source_quote: And a sick tiefling in a too-hot room, shivering despite the fire, grieving the last argument she'd had with someone she'd loved.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum retrieved a crumpled piece of wrapping paper from the dining hall trash and noticed a straight edge where there shouldn't be one.
source_quote: I turned it over in my hands. Torn in several places, the way paper tears when you're unwrapping something with reasonable enthusiasm. But there was something else. A straight edge where there shouldn't be one.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum used a cantrip to restore the wrapping paper to its original state and observed a clean cut, separate from the ragged tears.
source_quote: The paper did the rest. There it was. A clean cut, straight as a rule, separate from all the ragged tears.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum concluded the clean cut indicated the wrapping paper had been deliberately cut and reused, suggesting premeditation.
source_quote: That is not a crime of opportunity. That is a crime of preparation.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum realized the wrapping paper had been used to wrap a deadly book.
source_quote: The gift wrap for the deadly book.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum believed the crime required calm, preparation, and patience, and that the perpetrator had planned for what happened after Janussi was dead.
source_quote: That is the kind of detail that belongs in a file you keep very carefully.

subject: Alkrist
fact: Alkrist entered Janussi's chambers with a rehearsed performance of grief, intending it to be witnessed.
source_quote: The performance started before he sat down. ... he deployed grief the same way: deliberately, as an announcement he wanted witnessed.

subject: Alkrist
fact: Alkrist believed he had a fantastic, superb relationship with Janussi.
source_quote: I had a fantastic, superb relationship with the man.

subject: Alkrist
fact: Alkrist was pleased when Thorin took his grief at face value, mistaking sincerity for sincerity.
source_quote: He took it as sincere. He was pleased.

subject: Alkrist
fact: Alkrist resented Janussi for dismissing his germ warfare research as dangerous and telling him he showed no leadership potential.
source_quote: dismissed, told his germ warfare research was dangerous and should be stopped, told he showed no leadership potential.

subject: Alkrist
fact: Alkrist had been studying the Midnight Tears method from 1001 Tashalian Nights and had bookmarked the relevant section.
source_quote: The book was on a shelf, bookmarked. ... There was a class ... about what you find in someone's room telling you more than what they'd ever say with their face. I found the book anyway.

subject: Alkrist
fact: Alkrist's hand drifted toward the shelf when asked how he proposed dealing with Janussi.
source_quote: His hand moved toward the shelf before his mouth had finished the sentence.

subject: Alkrist
fact: Alkrist confessed he had placed midnight tears on the book, unwrapped it, coated it, and re-wrapped it.
source_quote: The Oak Tree Apothecary, the stolen vial, peppermint spilled on the counter floor. Daral's present, unwrapped and coated in midnight tears and carefully re-wrapped.

subject: Alkrist
fact: Alkrist washed his hands in a basin of water after burning the vial's label, fearing contamination.
source_quote: he had washed his hands in it, just in case there was any midnight tears on them.

subject: Alkrist
fact: Alkrist insisted he did not kill Janussi, only poisoned the book.
source_quote: I didn't actually kill him. I just put some poison on a book.

subject: Alkrist
fact: Alkrist claimed he was under mind control and therefore forced to tell the truth against his will.
source_quote: He was being forced, he said, to tell things that were true, against his will.

subject: Alkrist
fact: Alkrist was genuinely confused when told Janussi's heart had been ripped out.
source_quote: Ripped out his heart? What? His heart was ripped out?

subject: Alkrist
fact: Alkrist believed Bookwyrm had reacted with appallment to his plan and had stormed off after their argument.
source_quote: Appalled, he said. She had been appalled, and they argued, and then she was gone.

subject: Bookwyrm's motive
fact: Bookwyrm's motive for ripping out Janussi's heart remains unexplained, though she had argued with Alkrist after learning of the poisoning.
source_quote: That was Bookwyrm," I said, mostly to myself.

subject: Bookwyrm's knowledge
fact: It is unknown whether Bookwyrm knows a powerful polymorph spell, though she was present at the scene after the poisoning.
source_quote: Does he think Bookwyrm knows a powerful polymorph spell?
